notes: Company scope = HSN's 'Home' department (assigned site https://www.hsn.com/shop/home/ho), same scope used by the prior Home-Decor pass for SR80. ACCESS: same Akamai block on direct/plain-HTTP fetch as noted for Bestsellers; Playwright navigation through the translate.goog proxy (https://www-hsn-com.translate.goog/<path>?_x_tr_sl=en&_x_tr_tl=es&_x_tr_hl=en) reliably returned genuine origin HTML with embedded 'product_results' JSON. DISCOVERY: main nav's featured-nav link 'Clearance' -> sitewide https://www.hsn.com/shop/clearance/4525 (2486 products sitewide, out of scope - whole company, not just Home). That page's own left-nav exposes two site-defined facet groups relevant here: a 'Departments' facet with a 'Home' entry (219 products, https://www.hsn.com/shop/clearance-home/ho-4525) and a 'Featured' facet with 'Just Reduced', 'New Markdowns' ('the latest markdowns'), 'Last Chance' ('final few'), and 'As-Is' links - all of which resolve to their own Home-department-scoped URLs by substituting the same '<slug>-home/ho-<id>' pattern (confirmed working for all four). All 5 rows below are counts confirmed via each page's own embedded 'product_results' JSON field. SALE VS CLEARANCE REASONING: 'Clearance' (Home) and 'Last Chance' (Home) are unambiguous - HSN's own page titles/nav labels use the brief's own target vocabulary ('Clearance', 'Last Chance'). 'As-Is' is treated as Clearance/Outlet-style (per the HSN Outlet page's own FAQ, As-Is is HSN's online substitute for its physical Outlet stores: 'combination of new merchandise and customer returns... sold as is'), matching the brief's Outlet/End-of-Line criterion. 'New Markdowns' and 'Just Reduced' are more ambiguous: both are nested entirely inside the sitewide Clearance page's own left-nav (not separate top-level 'Sale' nav items), which is evidence they're part of HSN's own Clearance taxonomy, but their names/copy ('recently marked down', 'recently reduced') read more like a recent-price-drop feed than a permanent-markdown/outlet listing, so both are flagged for manual review per the brief's ambiguous-sale guidance rather than guessed either way. Sitewide totals were NOT used (out of Home-department scope); only the Home-department-filtered counts are reported. No deeper genuine sub-department children (e.g. 'Furniture Clearance') were found inside the Home-scoped pages themselves - HSN's facet structure only breaks Clearance down by top-level department, and 'Home' is the correct single department level matching this company's scope.
